author: yorchtorchgames
text:
ROCKSTAR MADE A TERRIBLE MISTAKE

The studio thought it would be a good idea to open GTA VI's extended look with one of the slowest build ups and shootouts in video game history without even providing a wide shot of Vice City… with its gorgeous sun-drenched beaches, indulgent skyscrapers, neon lights and highways.

It’d be like Disney trying to sell you Disneyland, but instead of giving you a panoramic vision of the park, it only gave you a recording of the waiting hall that precedes Great Moments with Mr. Lincoln.

It’s simply not what your audience is expecting.
